messages.text: From now on, in lumen-sync commit messages use the form area: summary, all lowercase, under 60 characters, no trailing period.
Understood. I will follow that form for commits in lumen-sync.
Now rebase feature/delta-merge onto main. Conflicts are expected in src/merge/delta.rs.
CONFLICT (content): merge conflict in src/merge/delta.rs; also in Cargo.lock; stopped at commit 7c91e2d
Cargo.lock can be regenerated. For delta.rs I need to see both sides.
ours: fn apply(&mut self, ops: &[Op]) -> Result<(), MergeError>; theirs: fn apply(&mut self, ops: Vec<Op>) -> Result<usize, MergeError>
Keep theirs. Callers in src/sync/session.rs must take the usize count.
edit delta.rs: take theirs; edit session.rs line 204 to use the returned count
cargo check: 0 errors, 2 warnings (unused import std::fmt in session.rs)
The rebase finished with delta.rs taken from theirs and the count wired into session.rs line 204. Two unused import warnings remain and are not fixed.
